summary_en: FY3/27 dividend per share raised to ¥53 (¥27 interim, ¥26 final) from ¥46 guidance. Interim dividend +¥4, final dividend +¥3. Payout ratio basis 40% of full-year earnings; floor dividend ¥30/share maintained. Prior year FY3/26 paid ¥59 (¥24 interim, ¥35 final).
title_en: Notice Regarding Modification of Consolidated Earnings Forecast for FY3/27 and Modification (Dividend Increase) of Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
On 4 August 2026, Iino Kaiun's board of directors approved an upward revision of the FY3/27 dividend forecast based on improved earnings outlook. The interim dividend per share has been raised by ¥4 to ¥27, and the final dividend per share has been raised by ¥3 to ¥26, bringing the full-year dividend to ¥53 per share, compared to the prior guidance of ¥46 per share (¥23 interim, ¥23 final). The prior fiscal year FY3/26 paid ¥59 per share (¥24 interim, ¥35 final).

The company's dividend policy targets a 40% payout ratio on full-year earnings as the baseline, while maintaining a floor dividend of ¥30 per share to enhance stability and predictability amid the volatility of the shipping market. The upward revision reflects better-than-expected performance in the first quarter of FY3/27, with chemical tanker and dry bulk markets trading at elevated levels. Management also expects dry bulk market conditions to remain steady in subsequent quarters and anticipates profit increases from favorable contract renewals on certain vessels. The forecast assumes USD/JPY rates of ¥155 from Q2 onwards (versus ¥150 previously) and normalized transit through the Strait of Hormuz from October 2026.
